title: Vaporesources
lede: A Neocities collection of old computer graphics, introduced by a CRT monitor on a grid floor, a broken marble head, and letter-spaced magenta capitals.
summary: Sage-green page with a CRT on a grid floor, a marble head, and spaced magenta serif capitals.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Clear on imagery and type, not on palette: a CRT monitor on a receding grid, a fragment of a classical head, spaced capitals, and an embedded vaporwave track, but on a sage-green ground instead of pastel pink.

observed: A narrow column with a thin black outline is centred on a flat sage-green page.
At the top, a photograph shows a beige AT&T CRT monitor standing on a receding blue-and-white grid floor.
WELCOME TO VAPORESOURCES is set in bold magenta Times capitals with a space between every letter.
A cut-out fragment of a classical marble head sits below, above a spaced blue “G a l l e r y” link and a small Bandcamp player.
interpretation: The spaced heading is typed with a space between each letter, not set with CSS letter-spacing, so the measured heading tracking is 0. The grid floor is inside a photograph, so pattern share is 0 too.

images.alt: Vaporesources home page: sage-green background, a narrow outlined column with a CRT monitor photographed on a grid floor, the spaced magenta heading WELCOME TO VAPORESOURCES, a marble head fragment, a Gallery link, and a small music player.
images.caption: First viewport of [vaporesources.neocities.org](https://vaporesources.neocities.org/).
